messages:
Kai (MarinTek): Hey team — MarinTek needs to onboard a hybrid ensemble for support summarization. Key constraints: PHI in transcripts, cannot ship raw logs off-site, must use HSM/KMS for keys, and prefer Dedicated or Private deployment. Pilot renewal is in ~6 weeks so low-risk path preferred. Can we kick off intake?
Maya (CS): Thanks Kai — noted the PHI + HSM requirement. Quick Qs: what traffic are you expecting (rps), latency SLO, and do you need an SLA? Also confirm retention/PII rules.
Kai (MarinTek): Peak ~50 req/s, typical 10–15. Latency target ~500ms p95 for summary endpoint. Budget tight for 70B but open to mixed approach (13B tuned + a distilled larger model for edge cases). They need a BAA and logs must stay in-custody.
Jon (SolutionsEng): Understood. We'll need: model artifacts or model family names, sample prompts, and a labeled eval set — please provide ~50 golden examples + ~200 negative/challenge cases (PHI redaction edge cases). Also confirm input schema (audio transcript JSON) and max tokens.
Devon (Onboarding): I'll schedule a kickoff with MarinTek and ops. Proposed rollout: preprod -> canary (2%) -> 10% -> full, with automatic fallback to smaller model if latency spikes. Need allowlist IPs/DNS and a service account for deploys. ETA for intake doc by EOD tomorrow?
Leah (Security): Security notes: Dedicated deployment preferred given PHI. We need their threat model, dataflow diagram, and attestation for their HSM if they manage keys. We'll run a dependency scan and a config review. Also propose network isolation and strict IAM roles.
Kai (MarinTek): Can do — I'll upload eval samples and the dataflow diagram to the S3 bucket: https://s3.company.com/marintek/onboard-1684012345 (access shared with redwood-onboard-sa). Also they can provide HSM attestation by next week.
Maya (CS): Flagging renewal risk — pilot renewal in ~6 weeks. I'm marking this high-priority for enablement and renewals. We'll capture feedback points during canary and schedule weekly syncs.
Jon (SolutionsEng): For the eval harness, suggested config: ```yaml
eval_config:
  golden_examples: 50
  adversarial_cases: 200
  metrics: [rouge_l, exact_match, phi_redaction_rate]
  canary_thresholds:
    latency_p95: 600ms
    phi_fails: 0
```
Devon (Onboarding): I'll create the shared intake doc and a PR in the eval-harness repo. Devon -> will ping infra for a Dedicated pool quote and IP allowlist steps.
deploy-bot: New intake created: #intake-1684012345-marintek (assigned to Maya, Jon, Devon).
Maya (CS): I'll own the renewal playbook and weekly CS check-ins. Please tag me when you upload the eval sets.
Kai (MarinTek): Thanks — uploading now. Appreciate the fast turnaround, team.
Leah (Security): Once we have the attestation and dataflow, I'll start the review.
Maya (CS): Capturing action items: 1) Kai — upload evals + diagram (today). 2) Jon — draft eval harness + thresholds. 3) Devon — kickoff + Dedicated quote. 4) Leah — security review kickoff. 5) Maya — renewal playbook and weekly sync invite.
Kai (MarinTek): Got it, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
